learn.title: What is an equation?
learn.body: An equation says two expressions are equal, such as $x+7=12$. Solving it means finding the value of $x$ that makes it true. Think of a balance: whatever you do to one side, you must do to the other.

learn.title: Inverse operations
learn.body: To get $x$ alone, undo the operation attached to it. Addition is undone by subtraction, and subtraction by addition. Multiplication is undone by division, and division by multiplication. Do the same to both sides.

learn.title: Solve $\frac{x}{5}=4$
learn.body: $x$ is divided by 5, so multiply by 5.

learn.title: Negative answers
learn.body: The answer can be negative. For $x+8=3$, subtract 8 from both sides: $x=3-8=-5$. Check: $-5+8=3$, so it works. Remember the sign rules from the integers unit.
Always check by putting your answer back into the original equation.

questions.explanation: Division is undone by multiplication, so $x=4\times 5=20$.
Putting $x=6$ gives $6+4=10$, which is true. $2x=6$ gives $x=3$.

questions.prompt: Match each equation with its solution.
questions.explanation: Undo each operation: subtract 3, add 3, then multiply by 3.
